name: System Applications
description: Manage local applications and system window states.

actions.name: open_program
actions.description: Launch a local application or a web app shortcut.

program_name.description: Name of the binary or application (e.g., "spotify", "vscode", "terminal").

actions.name: key_command
actions.description: Direct window controls via automated key presses.

actions.name: find_program
actions.description: Checks if a program is installed by searching for the best match.

actions.name: close_program
actions.description: Attempts to close the current active window.
